name: Daikin Mini Split
author: keylimesoda
description: Daikin BRP072A43 mini-split controller: power, mode, temperature, fan, swing, live sensors (local HTTP API, no cloud). Auto-discovers the adapter on your LAN.

barWidget.description: Control the Daikin mini-split: power, mode, setpoint, fan, swing, live sensors. The adapter is found by a local-subnet scan on first run. Right-click toggles power.

schema.label: Device IP
schema.description: Optional. Leave empty to auto-discover the adapter on the local subnet (recommended).

schema.description: Display units for setpoints and sensors.
